title: God Stones and Crown Relics
notes: God Stones: one for each of the nine living gods. Any open hollow of your Tree of Life takes one, like a rune stone. Its god's blessing works on you (Cevel's: more damage to the wounded; Delthius's: magic find, Luck and gold; Obliveion's: damage added as Null...), and the skills of the route it sits in deal 10% more. Only one stone of each god counts; a Holy Knight's stones are 50% stronger.
God Stones drop from Ascension 20, and a Divine One often drops its own god's.

Crown relics, the dead gods' great pieces: the Gavel-Hand (every 8s a gavel crushes the nearest enemy), the Keystone Spine (unhit for 4s: +25% damage and 15% less damage taken) and the Hollow Maw (kills are devoured: heal and stacking damage). Each takes two neighbouring hollows of one route; only one counts at a time. Bosses drop them from Ascension 50.
The Tree window's Rune Bag is now the Stone Bag: rune stones, God Stones and Crown relics. New Game Guide page: God Stones & Crown Relics.
